annotations.title: Create a public link to a signal

description: Makes a public link to one signal that anyone with the address can open. A new link replaces the old one, which stops working. The plan sets how long a link can live; Starter and a paused workspace allow 24 hours. Send an idempotency_key. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the first answer and does not act again.

expiry.description: How long the link works. Starter and a paused workspace allow only 24h, and any other choice becomes 24h there.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make for this request, such as a UUID. Send the same key when you retry, and Debriefing returns the first answer instead of acting twice.

include_notes.description: Show the team's talking points on the public page

signal_id.description: An id from search_signals or what_changed

name: create_share_link

replayed.description: True when this answer repeats an earlier call with the same idempotency_key.
